_readme: Hand corrections every run applies (see README.md here). exclude: [{id, why}] drops an item. level: {id: n} overrides the level shown. source: {id: text} overrides the Source column. include: [{builds?, item: LevelingItem}] adds an item the database can't see yet (omit builds for all six). allow: [id] lets a world drop or rare spawn count as chaseable (or a PvP-flagged item). dpsEp: {"<spec>/<build>": {main, off, ranged}} overrides the EP per weapon DPS point for one build. pins: [{id, why, roles?, builds?, force?}] are items you know matter but the model can't see: the report says where each landed; they are forced into the list for the builds and slots they fit (roles/builds narrow that), or set force: false to only report. ppm: {"<itemId>": n} sets a known procs-per-minute for an on-hit effect whose rate the database doesn't give (otherwise 1 is assumed). notAtLaunch: {zones: [zone ids], reps: [reputation faction ids]} keeps drops, vendors and reputation rewards from those out, and crafted items whose recipe drops or is sold there (Dire Maul is 2557). allowEpic: [ids] lets an epic below level 60 in: epics are blocked by default because most are raid-era or post-launch rewards. maxRepLevel: the highest reputation standing a player is assumed to reach while leveling (6 = Honored; RepLevel in the Forever proto). cityDungeons: {zoneId: 'Alliance'|'Horde'} dungeons inside a capital, practical for that side only. dungeonInZone: {zoneId: name} dungeons the database files under an outdoor zone. questSide: {questId: 'Alliance'|'Horde'} sets which side can take a quest when the database records none (it treats those as both sides); verify on Wowhead. 'Both' records that both sides were checked.recipeVerified: [ids] crafts whose recipe source was confirmed by hand when Wowhead doesn't list one (they drop off the report's check list). questMinLevel: {questId: n} the quest's verified "Requires level" on Wowhead, applied when higher than the item's own requirement. excludeReps: [names] reputations earned through battlegrounds (PvP): their vendor and reputation gear is out, matched by name against the database's reputation list and the tooltip's "Requires <faction> - <standing>" line.

exclude.why: Bold Dirk: its recipe is sold by Pexmit in zone 616 (Mount Hyjal), which isn't open at launch. Remove if that turns out wrong.
Zandalarian Shadow Talisman: Zul'Gurub item, not available in current content.

pins.why: Thrash Blade: 'Chance on hit: grants an extra attack'. A slow-weapon main hand for Sinister Strike.

notAtLaunch.why: Dire Maul isn't in the game at launch.
